# Backward compatibility

<!-- source: https://publications.pages.asam.net/standards/ASAM_OpenDRIVE/ASAM_OpenDRIVE_Specification/v1.8.1/specification/05_backward_compatibility/05_backward_compatibility.html -->

## 5 Backward compatibility

ASAM OpenDRIVE 1.8.1 is backwards compatible with ASAM OpenDRIVE 1.8.0.

As a maintenance version, it fixes some bugs present in 1.8.0 and introduces a new chapter, but all existing features from ASAM OpenDRIVE 1.8.0 remain supported.
For a full list of changes see  [Annex F.1, *Revision history ASAM OpenDRIVE 1.8.0*](../16_annexes/revision_history/ASAM_OpenDRIVE_revision_history_V1-8-0.html#top-8014cba9-57bc-4b2e-b07c-44dcc0886381-1-8-0).
